digest.component_or_area: CLI guidance and library interface (transition + claim commands)
propositions: transition and claim lib interfaces have inconsistent force-bypass signatures; transition splits force across force(bool), reason, and force_close params while claim uses force(str|None)
the force-bypass audit reason is conceptually coupled to --force but transition CLI permits --reason as a fallback force-note while claim does not
internal naming for the force-bypass reason concept is spelled four different ways (force_reason, force_close, force_close_reason, force_plan_review) across transition and claim
legacy calls to transition(force_close=x) and transition(force=True) have no deprecation migration path to the unified force(str|None) shape
guidance strings in gates.py and txn.py show inconsistent CLI patterns (--force --reason vs --force=<reason>) for the same operation across transition and claim
